violation_type.title: Orientation-Handling Emergencies (26 TAC §744.1303(4))
violation_type.typical_finding: Through the course of the investigation it was found that two caregivers present did not have orientation to the site that would have helped them better handle an incident of a child having a serious injury.

finding_variants.text: Through the course of the investigation it was found that two caregivers present did not have orientation to the site that would have helped them better handle an incident of a child having a serious injury.
Based on information gathered through the course of the DFPS investigation, it was determined that the staff did not know about a child's diagnosis and medication prior to the child having a seizure.
